figurative_meaning_bn: চুপ করে থাকা বা কথা না বলা
figurative_meaning_en: To remain silent or keep quiet
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে সব কথা জেনেও মুখ বুজে থাকলো।
এই বিষয়ে মুখ বুজে থাকাই ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: He knew everything but kept his mouth shut.
It's better to keep quiet on this matter.
note: This idiom emphasizes the value of silence in Bengali social interactions.
